params.name: tokenIn
params.description: input token address

params.name: tokenOut
params.description: output token address

params.name: amount
params.description: input token amount

params.name: fee
params.description: amount of the fee, for example 0.0025 (0.25%)

params.name: feeBy
params.description: if fee > 0 then which token to take fee from input or output

params.name: maxPriceImpact
params.description: the max price impact for route planning. It's better to set it to a reasonable value, for example 1 (100%)

params.name: maxSlippage
params.description: the max slippage for route execution, for example 0.005 (0.5%)

params.name: onlyDEX
params.description: a list of DEX names separated by comma. If exists in the request then only pools from these DEXes are used in the response route. List of all supported DEXes can be obtained with /liquidity-provider request

params.name: onlyPools
params.description: a list of pools addresses separated by comma. If exists in the request then only these pools are used in the response route

params.name: excludeDEX
params.description: a list of DEX names separated by comma. If exists in the request then pools from these DEXes are excluded in the response route. List of all supported DEXes can be obtained with /liquidity-provider request

params.name: excludePools
params.description: a list of pools addresses separated by comma. If exists in the request then these pools are excluded in the response route

params.name: excludeTokens
params.description: a list of token addresses separated by comma. If exists in the request then pools with these tokens are excluded in the response route

params.name: visualize
params.description: vizulaization
